title: Hunger Games author Suzanne Collins calls Sunrise on the Reaping "vibrant and devastating"
summary: In a rare public statement, the writer praised the new film a week before it opens.
body:
Suzanne Collins, author of The Hunger Games, has praised the new film of her novel Sunrise on the Reaping in a rare public statement.

In a letter to fans shared by the studio Lionsgate on 13 November, Collins called the film a "vibrant and devastating" adaptation. She said director Francis Lawrence had kept the book's story and themes while giving it his own distinctive style.

Praise for the cast

Collins also praised Joseph Zada, who plays the young Haymitch Abernathy, and the rest of the cast. She has not taken part in the film's publicity tour.

The film opens in US cinemas on Friday 20 November, after its premiere in London last month.

Sources: People, Screen Rant, CBR.
